packs.promise: Connect Atlanta’s public landmarks with art, civil rights history and a wider city view.

q.s: Make a movement key with a simple mark or a movement word for each animal and its displayed name.
st: Enter with aquarium admission and choose an open viewing gallery.
Observe three animals moving differently: turning, gliding, hovering or resting all count.

q.s: Record the action, the obstacle it addressed and one source detail that makes the account concrete.

q.s: After leaving the station, note one cue that helps you find the Woodruff Arts Center area.

packs.title: Along the Eastside
packs.promise: Follow a former rail corridor through markets, neighborhood paths and public art.

q.s: Make a small abstract design, or describe one in words, showing what happens when those colors touch.
st: Use a permitted sidewalk position outside or at the tunnel entrance, clear of traffic.
Choose two neighboring painted colors without copying a whole artwork.
Make a small abstract design, or describe one in words, showing what happens when those colors touch.

q.s: Connect the three material details in a tiny diagram or a written note explaining how each supports the market’s current use.
st: Browse an open customer aisle without blocking vendors.

Connect the three material details in a tiny diagram or a written note explaining how each supports the market’s current use.

q.s: Write one sentence describing the shape of this small valley without using the word green.
st: Enter an open park path or choose a permitted resting spot near the entrance.
For two minutes, notice how the ground rises and falls around you.
